context.hypothesis_source: The first 80% historical LP study showed stronger realized outcomes when public LP entries followed <=2 swaps in the prior 30 minutes. The original 60/20 validation slice influenced this hypothesis, so it is now treated as development evidence rather than confirmatory validation.
context.holdout: The final 20% chronological history remains outcome-blind and is not read by this counterfactual development test.

signal.entry: first block after the finalized mint block

paper_position.sizing_basis: exact active-bin quote liquidity at counterfactual entry
paper_position.exit: full removal plus executable same-pool residual inventory unwind

interpretation.next_if_promising: expand to >=20 development counterfactuals across >=3 pools, freeze exact rule, then expose untouched final-20% holdout
interpretation.costs: Initial diagnostic reports pre-wallet-gas gross economics; no profitability claim until historical gas/cycle cost sensitivity is applied.
